title: Le Figaro: ownership and control
summary: Le Figaro is a French national general-news daily and digital publication. Its publisher, Société du Figaro, identifies Dassault Médias as its shareholder with more than 95%. Dassault Médias belongs to Groupe Industriel Marcel Dassault. The journalists’ society holds a small shareholding and supervisory-board appointment rights.

edges.description: Annex 2 of the official editorial charter states that the journalists’ society holds three shares. The corresponding percentage is not disclosed.
The charter grants the journalists’ society rights to designate members of Société du Figaro’s supervisory board. This establishes representation, not majority control.

gaps: Searches for recent sales found no verified completed transfer away from Dassault. This does not establish that every transaction or filing has been captured.
The official legal notice and editorial charter are undated. Their ownership-observation dates remain null.
The latest opened primary evidence quantifying GIMD’s interest in Dassault Médias is dated 31 December 2023; continuing control is corroborated by the 2025 Euromedia report.

The exact Société du Figaro capitalization, other minority holdings and voting-right percentages were not established. Consolidated accounts showing 100% at group level do not override the charter’s explicit three-share journalists’ holding.

Groupe Figaro SAS, SIREN 401 328 919, and Dassault Médias, SIREN 662 053 180, are distinct legal entities despite overlapping group terminology. No unsupported intermediate ownership link has been inserted.
Tracing stops at GIMD under the three-level limit; ultimate family beneficial ownership is not resolved in this graph.
